sources.snippet: Multi-task learning (MTL) is a machine learning method that has witnessed exponential traction due to its ability to solve multiple tasks simultaneously. Joining training-related tasks in MTL improves both predictive performance and data efficiency. The shared knowledge across tasks enables MTL models to outperform traditional single-task models. sources.snippet: A multi-task model There are two critical parts to multi-task recommenders: They optimize for two or more objectives, and so have two or more losses. They share variables between the tasks, allowing for transfer learning.
